purpose: Independent low-level CPU cost evidence for candidate materialization and original-DLL top-k=1 apply only.

patterns.formula: float(i-V/2)/float(V), i=0..V-1; powers-of-two V make exact binary32 unique values

patterns.algorithm: descending Fisher-Yates, xorshift32(13,17,5), unsigned modulo i+1; seed20260916 reset for each V

launch: sequential independent processes in fixed order 0/control,3/treatment,1/control,4/treatment,2/control,5/treatment; same selected logical CPU
case_order: case_id=(process_index*2+offset)%6, offset0..5; V indexed by case_id/2, pattern by case_id%2
single_thread: one explicitly pinned host thread; no custom worker thread, no llama_backend_init, no model/context load, no backend sampler initialization

stages.implementation: GetProcAddress-resolved original llama.dll llama_sampler_apply with llama_sampler_init_top_k(1)
stages.timed_scope: one original exported apply call only; input has sorted=false, selected=-1,size=V
stages.allocation: DLL load and sampler init occur once per process outside all stage windows. Work/baseline buffers allocate before stage; top-k sampler reused as source-proven stateless filter.
stages.input_reset: One of two frozen arms, in the same preallocated work vector outside QPC; each arm has full bitwise candidate validation outside QPC. This shared validation itself warms the input; the contrast only tests residual effects under this observer regime.
stages.quality: Exact unique argmax id and float bits, p=0,size=1,sorted=true,selected=-1,unchanged backing pointer checked outside clock. Filter output is not a committed sampled token.

first_use: First top-k apply after frozen reset and bitwise check, separate from steady samples; no candidate stage timer.

clock.observer_adjustment: record independently; do not subtract noisy observer samples or add stage walls
clock.timed_windows: sequential, disjoint, non-nested; no combined candidate+topk stage is reported

identity.actual_cpu_identity_capture: After root compile and before measurement, the identity-only executable pins the selected CPU and captures CPUID brand/signature, group count, group-0 active processor count, selected logical CPU and exact thread affinity mask. This actual probe-derived record becomes the measurement allowlist.
identity.actual_cpu_identity_gate: The run freeze requires one immutable actual_cpu_identity_freeze. Every process and every stage CPU observation must match it exactly for group/logical CPU/affinity. Local OS correlation is recorded only as context and is never filled in as an expected CPU identity.
identity.cpu: CPUID brand/signature, logical CPU/group, exact thread affinity, process/thread IDs
identity.frequency: CallNtPowerInformation ProcessorInformation before/after each stage; records max/current/limit MHz
identity.frequency_limits: Reported max/current/limit MHz must all remain identical for timing_usable=true. Any change produces diagnostic_only=true and timing_usable=false; stable reported MHz still does not prove constant effective turbo or cycles.
identity.runtime: absolute loaded llama.dll and ggml/ggml-base paths; exports resolved to same module; native/runtime/source/header/compiler hashes bound pre/post
identity.compiler: MSVC x64 /std:c++17 /O2 /fp:strict /MD /EHsc /utf-8 /GL- /showIncludes; no native rebuild; asm listing of external candidate loop saved for later review

quality_gate.exactness: no tolerance; any synthetic output/view mismatch fails the process
quality_gate.integrity: full frozen source/runtime/exe/header refs match before and after each process
quality_gate.completeness: 6 process records, 6 cases and one timed top-k stage per process; one first-use,16warmup,64raw repeats per case. Complete denominator 36 stages and 2304 steady samples.
quality_gate.no_auto_retry: Exactly one series for this revision; any failure remains. No replacement process or new series after observation.
quality_gate.row_or_model_conditions: none; synthetic sizes and patterns only
quality_gate.identity: All six independent process records and every stage observation must match root-frozen actual CPU identity exactly. Actual process PID must equal launcher PID.
quality_gate.timing_acceptance: All 36 stage records require positive, unchanged max/current/limit MHz; P90/P10 <= 1.5; observer median/steady median <= 0.01 without subtraction; and each of 12 arm/case groups has three process medians within 5% of their median. Any failure makes the series diagnostic-only and accepted_for_timing_evidence=false.

train_holdout.rule: All sizes previously disclosed in R19 quality diagnostics. No fitting or independent validation claim.

frozen_before_measurement: protocol.json and source_identity_reset_r1.json plus loader_r4 dependency bindings
absolute native DLLs and exported API identity
CPU index, process count/order and warmup/repeat counts
reset policy arm mapping and source reset semantic proof
coverage_excluded: logit bias and model suppress tokens
full sampler chain and end-to-end engine cost
authorization: Root owns compilation and sequential execution under existing user authorization; no user reconfirmation required.

identity_capture.mode: compiled executable --identity-only, no native DLL, no model, no GPU, no QPC timing values
identity_capture.root_gate: root idle confirmation and identity authorization required
identity_capture.local_os_correlation: recorded by entry.py only; never an expected hardware identity

timing_quality_gate.stage_steady_dispersion: Each of all 36 stage records has 64 steady raw QPC ticks. Linear-interpolated P90/P10 must be <= 1.5; a nonpositive P10 is diagnostic-only.
timing_quality_gate.cross_process_medians: For every (reset_policy,V,pattern,stage) group, exactly three process steady medians are required. max(abs(process_median - median_of_process_medians))/median_of_process_medians must be <= 0.05; a nonpositive/nonfinite denominator is diagnostic-only.
timing_quality_gate.observer_overhead: For every stage, median of its process 64 empty-QPC-bracket ticks divided by its steady median must be <= 0.01. Empty brackets are recorded only and never subtracted; zero/nonfinite steady denominators are diagnostic-only.
timing_quality_gate.frequency: All three before/after fields os_max_mhz, os_reported_current_mhz and os_limit_mhz must be positive and equal. Unavailable (zero) is not stable; any difference is diagnostic-only.
timing_quality_gate.denominators: 6 processes x 6 cases x one timed top-k stage = 36 stages and 2304 steady samples; 2 arms x 6 cases = 12 cross-process groups, each with 3 medians.
timing_quality_gate.acceptance: Any failed timing-quality gate preserves raw results but requires timing_usable=false, diagnostic_only=true and accepted_for_timing_evidence=false. No timing extrapolation, coefficient fitting or observer subtraction is allowed.

loader_dependency_policy.failure_context: R19 R3 process 0 failed before timing with LoadLibraryEx selected llama.dll failure and completed_cases=[]; old build/identity/series remain immutable.
loader_dependency_policy.search_scope: AddDllDirectory only for frozen absolute runtime and E:/cuda/bin directories; no arbitrary PATH mutation, cwd search expansion, DLL copies or native rebuild.
loader_dependency_policy.lifetime: all CUDA and ggml preload handles plus AddDllDirectory cookies persist until llama sampler is freed, llama.dll is freed, then dependent handles/cookies are released in reverse order.
loader_dependency_policy.identity: entry verifies current SHA/bytes for five runtime modules and three CUDA dependencies before/after each process; C++ records actual loaded absolute paths for every frozen module and entry exact-matches them.
loader_dependency_policy.gpu_scope: CUDA dependency DLL loading is dependency resolution only. Probe makes no GPU API, context or performance calls; this flag does not make claims about DLL initialization side effects.

environment.source_basis: R18 direct microbench setup environment; child environment sets only this explicit value and does not alter PATH.

loader_dependency_policy.load_error: Every AddDllDirectory/LoadLibraryEx failure captures GetLastError code plus FormatMessage text immediately in the failed result.

raw_observation_schema.thread_affinity_mask: nonnegative JSON integer, same as actual_cpu_identity

run_budget.failure_action: preserve all results, report failure, switch mechanism; no repeated attempt until success

reset_ab.control: memcpy_baseline: memcpy prebuilt 12-byte candidate baseline into the same preallocated work vector outside QPC, then reset view.
reset_ab.treatment: source_candidate_loop: exact common/sampling.cpp candidate loop writes the same preallocated work vector from immutable logits outside QPC, then uses its view.
reset_ab.timed_scope: one original llama_sampler_apply(top_k=1) only; reset, quality check, allocation, loader and frequency observation remain outside.
reset_ab.denominators: 6 processes x 6 cases x one timed top-k stage = 36 stages and 2304 steady samples; 2 arms x 6 cases = 12 cross-process groups, each with 3 medians.
reset_ab.quality: Retain R19 thresholds unchanged: P90/P10 <=1.5, median deviation <=5%, observer <=1%, positive unchanged max/current/limit. Any failure diagnostic-only.
reset_ab.holdout: V=131072 remains an already-used quality diagnosis point only; no holdout cost read, formal blind claim or coefficient fitting.
